item.title: BTC Market Pulse: Bitcoin Holds Near $78,713 as 24-Hour Drift Eases
item.summary: Bitcoin closed at $78,712.78 on Alpaca at 2026-08-26 11:00 UTC, down 0.734483% over 24 hours within a $77,847–$79,563 range, while CryptoQuant reported $470 million in Binance USDC inflows and a 10-month high in US spot Bitcoin ETF weekly flows.
